name: Reflect
description: Background reflection pass that mines completed turns for memory-linked insights. Phase 0 runs in shadow mode: insights are scored and banked for /reflect digest review, never delivered.

agents.label: Target Agents
agents.help: Explicit agent ids that may run reflection. Empty means every agent.

scanModel.label: Scan Model
scanModel.help: Provider/model used for candidate discovery, e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5. Requires plugins.entries.reflect.llm.allowModelOverride: true; allowedModels optionally restricts the permitted targets. Defaults to the agent's configured model.

synthesisModel.label: Synthesis Model
synthesisModel.help: Provider/model used to draft the would-be follow-up for surface-tier insights. Defaults to the scan model.

preGate.label: Pre-Gate
preGate.help: Skip reflection for short or command-like transactional turns. Default on.

triage.surfaceThreshold.label: Surface Threshold
triage.surfaceThreshold.help: Minimum 0-100 score for the surface tier. In shadow mode surface-tier insights are banked with a drafted follow-up, never delivered. Default 85.

triage.deferThreshold.label: Defer Threshold
triage.deferThreshold.help: Minimum 0-100 score to bank an insight in the deferred store. Candidates below this are discarded. Default 60.

convergence.maxIterations.label: Max Iterations
convergence.maxIterations.help: Hard ceiling on retrieval/scan loop iterations per turn. Default 3.

convergence.stallIterations.label: Stall Iterations
convergence.stallIterations.help: Stop after this many consecutive iterations without new bankable candidates. Default 2.

convergence.loopTokenBudget.label: Loop Token Budget
convergence.loopTokenBudget.help: Per-turn model token ceiling for the reflection loop. Default 15000.

convergence.timeoutSeconds.label: Timeout (seconds)
convergence.timeoutSeconds.help: Wall-clock ceiling for one reflection pass. Default 120.

dailyTokenBudget.label: Daily Token Budget
dailyTokenBudget.help: Hard daily cap across all reflection passes; the pass is skipped when exhausted. Default 50000.

store.maxEntries.label: Store Max Entries
store.maxEntries.help: Maximum banked insight records; oldest are evicted beyond this. Default 400.

store.ttlDays.label: Insight TTL (days)
store.ttlDays.help: Banked insights expire after this many days. Default 90.

store.dedupeSimilarity.label: Dedupe Similarity
store.dedupeSimilarity.help: 0.5-1 token-overlap similarity above which a new insight merges into an existing record. Default 0.9.

logging.label: Verbose Logging
logging.help: Emit per-pass timing and outcome logs.
